notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hey, Animal Lovers! 🐾[/b][/h3]

We've just rolled out a new update for Pet Shop Simulator![b] This time, we've focused on fixing some minor bugs and adding a few gameplay improvements to make your experience even better.[/b]

[b]Patch notes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed earning the achievement for sending an employee to training for the first time.
[*] Fixed coupons in the self-service checkout that did not discount products
[*] Fixed the display of the wrong icon indicating what shelf a product will fit on.
[*] Fixed some products showing up on shelves in one color despite being ordered in different colors.
[*] Added a hanging sign whose content can be changed with a scanner.
[*] Added display of the quantity of a given product on the shelves and in the warehouse, as well as their total, when you point the mouse at the product in the tablet.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/348c22c2d7764370511857c14a99dd9802f7f931.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/2546ed4058cd614862000ecb1d6a811865c5b0a0.png[/img]



[b]As always, your support and feedback mean the world to us, so let us know how the game feels after this update. Thanks for being part of our community![/b]



See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Pet Shop Masters! 🐶🐱🐹[/h3]

We’ve got some awesome news for you! The new update for Pet Shop Simulator is now available and it includes a few fixes and improvements! 🎉

[b]🔧 WHAT’S NEW?[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved achievements : half a million, million, purchase of the entire parking lot
[*] Blocked the ability to remove fish tanks and terrariums with pets, causing them to show up in the warehouse

[b]Thanks for being with us and for your incredible energy. See you in the Pet Shop! 🐾🌟[/b]

See you soon,
The Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[h3]Dear Players! 🥳[/h3]

Over the past few days, you've been letting us know that you would like dogs and cats to appear in the game.
Changes take time, but we wanted to show you right now that we are working to implement your requests and suggestions into the game. 

[h3][b]As a result, dogs are coming to the game starting today![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/140ade5b3b71cd3aeda89c2bdfa2c1aa955e1d00.png[/img]

In its current form , the dogs will come to the store under the care of their owners , and you will be able to interact with them 🔥❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/e9670e0a9d8e0fb56e27b252db178014c16db3b6.png[/img]

Get ready for the next updates , because in them will appear our answers to your requests ✌️


[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Passersby received dogs, you can interact with them. 
[*] Added a new item - dog treat where the customer can approach with the dog. 
[*] Fixed some markings in the tablet on which shelves products should go to
[*] Fixed blocking of the employee with the customer
[*] The signature of the turtle terrarium has been corrected
[/list]

[h3][b]Please remember 🙏 currently it is not possible to own a pet on property or sell dogs ☝️[/b][/h3]


Thank you for your activity!



See you soon, 
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Dear players![/b]

[h3]Today we have published another update within these few days of the release. 

There have been many voices from you saying that the game is developing too fast for some while others had absolutely the opposite opinion. 
[/h3]

[b]Therefore, one of the most important novelties in this update is the difficulty levels!
There are 3 levels : 
[/b]
[b]Easy:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buying additional store space is cheaper
[*] Expanding the parking lot is cheaper
[*] Customers are rarely in a bad mood
[*] Employees are less likely to take their salaries
[*] No thieves
[*] Customers are happy to choose products, regardless of the margin
[*] Store equipment is cheaper
[*] The level of the store grows faster
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Normal:[/b]
[list]
[*] The price of additional store space is standard
[*] The cost of expanding the parking lot is standard
[*] Customers are sometimes in a bad mood
[*] Employees are paid hourly wages
[*] Thieves appear occasionally
[*] The customer's choice of product depends partly on the margin
[*] Store equipment has standard prices
[*] Store level is growing at a standard rate
[/list]

[b]Hard:[/b]
[list]
[*] Purchasing additional store space is more expensive
[*] Expanding the parking lot is more expensive
[*] Customers are more often in a bad mood
[*] Employees are paid hourly wages
[*] Thieves show up more often
[*] The customer's choice of product is more margin-dependent
[*] Store equipment is more expensive
[*] Store level is increasing at a standard rate
[/list]

New players from the very beginning of their adventure with our game will be able to choose the difficulty level in our game, [b]while players who have started the game before will be able to choose the difficulty level after updating and firing up their in-game save! :)[/b]


[h3]This is not the end of the news that we have prepared for you, but others will appear successively in the coming days and weeks.[/h3]



[b]Patch notes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added difficulty levels
[*] Added options to disable waving customers to cashiers
[*] Products on the way after saving and loading will go out again, so you won't lose them
[*] Fixed fish animations
[*] After skipping the night, the time is closer to the opening of the store
[*] Fixed product stuck over the bag if the product was not scanned beforehand
[/list]



See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Players! 🥳[/h3]

It's been the first 24 hours since the release of our game 🔥.
Thank you for your activity, many suggestions and feedback - it is thanks to them that we are able to improve and upgrade our game ✌️

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The set margin does not reset after saving and loading the game. 
[*] The shelf on which the product was set (visible on the price label) saves correctly, but without the physically stacked products. 
[*] Correctly refreshes the price of products in the shopping cart after loading the game. 
[*] Vehicles should no longer cause congestion on the street. 
[*] Product prices on shelves refresh after margin changes. 
[*] Modified notification regarding employees wanting to go on break. It should no longer suggest that the player himself has to send them on a break just inform them that they will go themselves in a short time.
[*] Fixed a bug in which a player could not move a piece of furniture that had already been purchased if the player had less money than its value. 
[*]The security guard will no longer try to catch a thief caught earlier
[*]The app with finances will not cut when starting it when there are a large number of items in the logs
[*]Customers won't open all the cubicles at once when they go to the bathroom 
[*]Customers go to the restroom a little more often

[/list]


Thank you for being there! 
Pet Shop Team
